# Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd)

Public name: Council of AI. Legal: CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677. did:web:csoai.org.
Neutral AI measurement body. Measurement, not certification. We do not certify, accredit, or issue conformity assessments.

## Live board (12 August 2026 stamp, UNSIGNED)

13 of the 14 GSPC registry axes are measured. The 14th slot (Human Baseline)
is measured against published aggregate human performance. The 16-axis arena
battery is a separate runtime object and is never conflated with the registry.
Shape: 13×19, 819 items. Source: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc

Live API names, in order:
governance, safety, provenance, continuity, conformance, openness, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality, detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect.

Affect is MEASURED. Labels stay counsel-pending and are not hidden.
Jail is a measured floor, empty on this stamp, not unmeasured. New stamp only. Not a ranking.
The 14th registry slot (Human Baseline) is measured via published aggregate baselines; our own human collection is DPIA-gated.

Do not quote scores from this file. Numbers live on the API.

## AEO

Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd, UK 16939677) measures AI systems. Anyone can check at https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify. The live board is 13 of the 14 GSPC registry axes measured on the 12 August 2026 UNSIGNED stamp (GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): governance, safety, provenance, continuity, conformance, openness, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality, detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect. Affect is MEASURED; labels stay counsel-pending and are not hidden. Jail is a measured floor, empty on this stamp, not unmeasured. New stamp only. Not a ranking. The 14th slot (Human Baseline) is measured via published aggregate baselines. This is measurement, not certification. The public verifies free. A grade is never sold.

## What we do not do

Measurement only. Nothing here is a conformity mark. This live stamp is UNSIGNED.
